tools.alternative: Administrator console: Content models, /api/v1/content-types and /api/v1/workflows, or bin/kumwe content-model.

tools.name: kumwe_workflow_list
tools.title: List workflows
tools.description: List the site's content workflows.
tools.alternative: Administrator console: Content models, /api/v1/content-types and /api/v1/workflows, or bin/kumwe content-model.

tools.name: kumwe_workflow_get
tools.title: Read a workflow
tools.description: Read one workflow by handle or id, optionally at a version.
tools.alternative: Administrator console: Content models, /api/v1/content-types and /api/v1/workflows, or bin/kumwe content-model.

tools.name: kumwe_workflow_create
tools.title: Create a workflow
tools.description: Create a content workflow from its states and transitions.
tools.alternative: Administrator console: Content models, /api/v1/content-types and /api/v1/workflows, or bin/kumwe content-model.

tools.name: kumwe_workflow_update
tools.title: Publish a workflow version
tools.description: Publish a new workflow version at the version you read.
tools.alternative: Administrator console: Content models, /api/v1/content-types and /api/v1/workflows, or bin/kumwe content-model.

tools.name: kumwe_business_definition_draft_save
tools.title: Save a definition draft
tools.description: Save a definition document as the working draft at the revision you read.
tools.alternative: Administrator console: Business definitions, or bin/kumwe business-definition.

tools.name: kumwe_business_definition_validate
tools.title: Validate a definition draft
tools.description: Validate the working draft with everything it reaches; the validation is audited.
tools.alternative: Administrator console: Business definitions, or bin/kumwe business-definition.

tools.name: kumwe_business_definition_supersede
tools.title: Supersede a definition version
tools.description: Mark one published definition version superseded.
tools.alternative: Administrator console: Business definitions, or bin/kumwe business-definition.

tools.name: kumwe_business_definition_deprecate
tools.title: Deprecate a definition version
tools.description: Mark one published definition version deprecated.
tools.alternative: Administrator console: Business definitions, or bin/kumwe business-definition.

tools.name: kumwe_business_definition_reject
tools.title: Reject a definition version
tools.description: Withdraw one published definition version so the runtime refuses it.
tools.alternative: Administrator console: Business definitions, or bin/kumwe business-definition.

tools.name: kumwe_business_relation_read
tools.title: Read a business relationship
tools.description: Read one record with exactly one declared relationship hydrated.
tools.alternative: The generated record screens, the protected REST record API, or bin/kumwe business-record.

tools.name: kumwe_studio_composition_get
tools.title: Read a Blueprint composition
tools.description: Read the Blueprint composition of one Content type version, with its document and dependencies.
tools.alternative: Administrator console: Content models, Compose, /api/v1/content-types/{id}/versions/{version}/composition, or bin/kumwe studio-composition.

tools.name: kumwe_studio_composition_provision
tools.title: Provision a Blueprint composition
tools.description: Provision the empty Blueprint draft of one Content type version, or answer the one bound.
tools.alternative: Administrator console: Content models, Compose, /api/v1/content-types/{id}/versions/{version}/composition, or bin/kumwe studio-composition.
